description: The 3D bar chart visualizes the metric of answer correctness across different combinations of language models and task types. The chart features two horizontal categorical axes and one vertical numeric value axis. The first categorical axis lists three language models in the order of "Davinci-003", "ChatGPT", and "BARD". The second categorical axis lists two task types: "Generation" and "Classification". The vertical value axis is labeled "Accuracy" and uses a linear scale with numerical tick marks displayed at 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8. The chart contains six bars arranged in a three-by-two spatial grid representing the intersection of the two categorical axes. All bars feature a vertical color gradient transitioning from blue at the base through green to yellow at the top, visually mapping to the height of the bar. For the "Generation" task type, the bars represent approximate accuracy values of 0.4 for Davinci-003, 0.2 for ChatGPT (the shortest bar in the visualization), and 0.4 for BARD. For the "Classification" task type, the bars represent approximate values of 0.75 for Davinci-003, 0.75 for ChatGPT, and slightly under 0.8 for BARD (the tallest bar). The categories are not sorted in strict alphabetical, ascending, or descending order. All bars are outlined with thin black lines, and no specific bars are individually emphasized with distinct annotations or shading variations.
